summary: Gold sank further into fear as a firmer dollar (DXY near 101.4, above its 30-day average) and elevated real yields (10Y TIPS at 2.83%) kept bullion oversold and dragged Treasuries lower, with TLT off 4.4% over two weeks. Risk appetite instead concentrated in crypto and mega-cap tech, leaving broader stock breadth thin even as headline indices held flat.
tweet: A stronger dollar and rising real yields crushed gold and bonds Monday, while risk appetite rotated narrowly into crypto and big tech.
